paras: Eurydactylodes occidentalis, the western chameleon gecko, is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Diplodactylidae. The species is endemic to Grande Terre in New Caledonia.
The word occidentalis, meaning "western", refers to the apparent restriction of the species along the west coast of South Province on Grande Terre.
The preferred natural habitat of E. occidentalis is forest, at an altitude of 20 m (70 ft).
E. occidentalis is the smallest species in its genus. Its maximum recorded snout-to-vent length (SVL) is only 5.3 cm (2.1 in).
